email.description: Patient email to send a consent request

installment.description: Amount to charge every week/2nd week/month according to period_type.

location_id.description: This field determines where to route funds for pre-service payment plans in case multiple bank accounts are connected. Should be empty in other cases.

phone.description: Patient phone to send a consent request

start_date.description:
ISO8601-formatted date string.

    :param kwargs: The same keyword arguments that :class:`Field` receives.

total_amount.description: Total amount to be charged on the payment plan.It is always equal to patient balance at payment plan subscription momentfor the "standard" type.

type.description: "standard" - post-service payment plan, "upfront" - pre-service payment plan
